title: Handley Page Hampden P4399
memorial_details: description: IN MEMORY OF/ THOSE WHO LOST THEIR LIVES/ NEAR THIS SITE ON THE 31 JULY 1941/ WHEN HAMPDEN BOMBER P4399 CRASHED/ KILLING 3 AIRCREW OF NO.61 SQUADRON/ AND 3 CIVILIANS OF DARTFORD./ RAF AIRCREW/ (Names)/ CIVILIANS/ (Names)/ THIS MEMORIAL WAS DEDICATED ON/ 10 NOVEMBER 2009 BY/ COUNCILLOR JEREMY KITE/ LEADER OF/ DARTFORD BOROUGH COUNCIL.
